1_executive_email.body:
Dear Codman Hakim (adjustable valve manufacturer) Technology Scouting / R&D Leadership,

I am writing to present a technology-transfer opportunity that may be of strategic interest to Codman Hakim (adjustable valve manufacturer).

## Technology
P-02 — Valve that adapts opening profile to ICP trends, reducing pressure excurs

## Why This May Matter to Codman Hakim (adjustable valve manufacturer), Sophysa
ICP excursion reduction is a clinical pain point. Adaptive valve profile could differentiate from fixed-pressure competitors.

## Current Evidence
- Technical readiness: T1
- Physical validation: NONE
- Evidence is transparent and auditable — every claim traces to a source artifact

## What Is NOT Proven (Honest Disclosure)
- NO_FAILURES_TESTED_YET — all evidence is MODELLED. Buyer should treat all claims as untested hypotheses until decisive experiment is commissioned.

## What We Are Asking
Request technical diligence. Commission additional computational verification OR the decisive experiment. Licensing is a subsequent route after technical maturity is established.

## Validation Investment
A defined experiment ($$10-20K, 6-12 months to T2) can upgrade this from T1 to externally verified status.

## Next Step
If this is of interest, I would welcome a 30-minute call to discuss:
1. Whether this fits your strategic roadmap
2. What evidence you would need to evaluate further
3. Whether a sponsored validation or co-development structure makes sense

I can share the full technical dossier under NDA.

Best regards,
[CEO Name]
CereVascular

2_one_page_opportunity_summary:
# P-02 — Technology Transfer Opportunity

**Technology:** P-02 — Valve that adapts opening profile to ICP trends, reducing pressure excurs
**Buyer:** Codman Hakim (adjustable valve manufacturer), Sophysa
**Current Evidence:** T1 | NONE
**Recommended Transaction:** SPONSORED_VALIDATION ($10-20K bench)
**Validation Cost:** $10-20K (6-12 months to T2)

## Problem
ICP excursions during postural changes cause patient symptoms and possible complications.

## Technology
P-02 — Valve that adapts opening profile to ICP trends, reducing pressure excursions

## Strategic Value
Next-gen adaptive valve

## What Is Proven
- Computational model: yes
- External verification: no
- Physical validation: no

## What Is NOT Proven
- NO_FAILURES_TESTED_YET — all evidence is MODELLED. Buyer should treat all claims as untested hypotheses until decisive experiment is commissioned.

## Strongest Alternative
Fixed-pressure programmable valve (Medtronic Strata) — no adaptation

## Decisive Question
Whether 47.3% reduction survives real hardware valve dynamics

## What We Are Asking You to Do
Request technical diligence. Commission additional computational verification OR the decisive experiment. Licensing is a subsequent route after technical maturity is established.

## BUYER_ACTION_ID: P02-EXP-001
